reta.basesHint: Bases are read-only here. The operator records them from the TGSS resolution.
reta.boundarySensitive: Your income is close to a bracket limit: a few more rows can move it to the next bracket.
reta.disclaimer: Decision support, not a TGSS resolution. These estimates are never added to or netted against the AEAT tax payments above.
reta.reasons.base_above_table_maximum: A recorded base exceeds the maximum of the imported table. Check the table and the base.
reta.reasons.base_below_table_minimum: A recorded base is below the table minimum (a special base); its regularisation is not modelled.
reta.reasons.base_missing: Some days registered in RETA (alta) have no recorded base. Record the base from your TGSS resolution.
reta.reasons.ledger_blocked: A ledger error blocks the income calculation; it also blocks the tax calculations.
reta.reasons.period_missing: A quarter with RETA registration (alta) has no ledger period yet. Record its rows.
reta.reasons.profile_unavailable: The check needs exactly one taxpayer profile.
reta.reasons.table_unavailable: The RETA table of this year is not imported yet.
reta.reasons.tarifa_plana_extension_unve: A reduced flat-rate contribution (tarifa plana) runs past month 12. Record the extension resolution from month 13, or the base that followed.
reta.reasons.unposted_rows_in_window: Some rows in the checked months are still in review or not posted. Post or reject them.
reta.reasons.window_empty: No regularisable day yet: no month of the year has ended, there is no RETA registration (alta), or only reduced flat-rate contribution (tarifa plana) days.
reta.reasons.worker_kind_changed: The worker kind changed during the year; the check does not split the year.
reta.reasons.worker_kind_floor_unverifie: Company members (societarios) and family members helping in the business (familiares colaboradores) have a minimum base the check does not model.
reta.regime: {regime, select, base {Elected base} tarifa_plana {Reduced flat-rate contribution (tarifa plana)} other {Other regime}}
reta.statusDetail.above_bracket: Your bases so far total more than the maximum of the contribution bracket (tramo). TGSS would refund the difference.
reta.statusDetail.below_bracket: Your bases so far total less than the minimum of the contribution bracket (tramo). TGSS would ask for an additional payment.
reta.statusDetail.ok: Your bases so far are between the minimum and maximum of the contribution bracket (tramo). Nothing would be regularised.
reta.statusDetail.unknown: The check has no result: an input is missing or cannot be verified.
reta.title: RETA bracket check {year}
reta.tramoValue: {table, select, reduced {Reduced table} general {General table} other {Table}}, bracket {tramo}
reta.workerKind: {kind, select, individual {Individual} societario {Company member (societario, LGSS art. 305.2.b or e)} colaborador {Family member helping in the business (familiar colaborador)} other {Other}}
